coverage: The focused UI test uses React Router MemoryRouter history with a mocked support API/auth boundary; it is not a physical browser reload or crash-recovery test.

Recovery history is limited to company/principal binding, an idempotency key, operation kind, and optional case UUID plus existing navigation/safe-context metadata. It does not store request description, reply, subject, or unrelated prior location state.

A remount performs read-only request receipt lookup; it does not automatically POST. Unknown outcomes retain the same key for explicit retry, and acknowledgements for a different account/company are ignored.
Native support API behavior was qualified by its separate earlier PostgreSQL evidence; this checkpoint records only the UI slice.
